title: Osdag Web
tagline: The web version of Osdag, FOSSEE's open-source steel design software. Engineers set up a connection, the design runs as a background job with live progress, and they get a 3D CAD model and a PDF report back.
result: I lead the 4-person team · in production at IIT Bombay

title: Arjun Guruji
tagline: Kannada books that work offline, audio with lyrics that follow along, and reminders for upcoming events. I built it in 2021 and still maintain it.

screenshot.alt: Three screens from the Arjun Guruji Play Store listing: the Book section, the Astottara section and the Audio section.

title: OpenLake: Retail Lakehouse
tagline: A retail data platform with batch and streaming paths, built on Spark, Airflow, Delta Lake and dbt. It feeds dashboards and a churn model, and writes scores back to a mock CRM. The same code runs locally or on Azure.

figure.caption: Batch and streaming paths, from the README.

title: Process Mining & Analytics
tagline: Give it an event log and it draws the process map, shows where cases wait longest and flags rework. The alignment algorithms run in Spring Boot, and the dashboard is React.

figure.caption: From an event log to a process map.

screenshot.alt: The process mining dashboard: a process map of an order fulfilment log, with the slowest steps listed beside it.
screenshot.caption: The process map for an order fulfilment log.

title: Portfolio Island
tagline: This portfolio as a small pixel-art island you can walk around. Each building opens a part of the site: projects, experience, skills. Built with Phaser and React.

title: Mechanics Sight
tagline: Beam analysis you can play with: change the loads and supports and the shear, moment and deflection diagrams update, with exact solutions and a worked calculation report.

title: BriefForge: Packaging Artwork Review
tagline: Checks packaging artwork against the approved product data and a rulebook: nutrition values, units, barcodes. Every finding shows its evidence, and anything uncertain goes to a person. Built solo at a hackathon.

screenshot.alt: BriefForge showing an unfolded granola carton marked with numbered review findings.
screenshot.caption: Artwork marked up with numbered findings.

figure.caption: How a piece of artwork gets checked.

title: Polkaflow
tagline: Build a Polkadot smart contract by drawing a flowchart. A custom code generator turns the flowchart into contract code, with AI help along the way.

screenshot.alt: Polkaflow workflow canvas with connected trigger, logic, wallet, and smart contract nodes.
screenshot.caption: The workflow canvas.

figure.caption: A flowchart on the left, a contract on the right.

title: Polar Bridge
tagline: Hackathon prototype for borrowing Polkadot tokens against rupees paid over UPI, with the collateral held on Stellar. I wrote the smart contracts and the relayer in a team of two.

title: Money Follows
tagline: An offline finance app for expenses, net worth, money split with friends and credit card bills. Everything stays on the phone in SQLite, with home screen widgets and backups you can move between devices.

title: SysSight
tagline: Small Python agents on each machine report their metrics to a FastAPI server, which stores them in TimescaleDB and shows them live. When a metric stays over its threshold, it sends a single Discord alert.

figure.caption: Agents on each machine report to one server.

title: Stainless Steel CSM Calculator
tagline: Designs stainless steel members with the Continuous Strength Method and shows its working: the clause behind each step, the formulas, the material curves and the final resistance.

title: Verdict Chain
tagline: A chargeback review prototype. AI pulls the evidence out of documents, fixed rules do the scoring, and each decision becomes a memo with citations, hashed to an EVM ledger.

title: IsoFold
tagline: Classifies geological folds from a photograph. Trace the fold, and it fits splines and uses dip isogons to name the class. Tested on synthetic folds, with a sensitivity analysis.

title: IS 800 Code Assistant
tagline: Ask a question about IS 800, India's steel design code, and get an answer that cites its clauses. Compares keyword, semantic and hybrid search, and checks every citation against the source text.
result: Keyword, semantic and hybrid search compared

figure.caption: A question in, a cited answer out.

title: Arjun Guruji Web
tagline: The web companion to Arjun Guruji: Kannada texts, audio that keeps playing while you browse, an events calendar, and a Panchang worked out in the browser for where you are.

title: Slope Stability Analyzer
tagline: Finds the critical slip circle for layered slopes with loads and groundwater. A Python toolkit with a web interface, plus a separate 3D analysis engine.

title: Paladin Java SDK PoC
tagline: A proof-of-concept Java SDK for Paladin, with a fluent transaction builder that retries failed requests without submitting twice. Tested against MockWebServer, so failures can be simulated without a live node.

title: PokeWars
tagline: A multiplayer arena game in Phaser. Players sign in with a wallet and fight with NFT characters, while Socket.IO runs the lobbies, combat and scores.

title: Agentic Workflow Builder
tagline: A drag-and-drop builder for AI workflows on React Flow, with a Python engine that runs them: AI steps, branches, variables, JSON import and export, and a log of every run.

title: Intelligent ETA Predictor
tagline: Predicts food delivery time in two parts, kitchen prep and travel, with a neural network for each. A FastAPI service turns live inputs into the exact features the models were trained on.

title: FinSight
tagline: A daily pipeline that pulls market news from Finnhub, scores its sentiment with Gemini and stores the totals in PostgreSQL. Airflow runs the bronze, silver and gold steps in Docker.

title: VoyageHunt
tagline: A tourism app prototype built with a team: treasure hunts, photo quests and leaderboards for visitors, and a side for local businesses. React Native and Supabase.

title: Vehicle Detection & PCU Prototype
tagline: Counts vehicles in traffic video with YOLOv8 and converts them to passenger car units, frame by frame. A Streamlit app with progress tracking, Plotly charts and CSV export.

title: GenkiSportz App Links
tagline: The link site behind a sports app's tournament and team invites. It opens the app when it's installed, falls back to a link you can copy when it isn't, and serves the Android and iOS association files.
